header.label: BIM / IFC viewer
header.title: Monty IFC Viewer
header.desc: Web-based IFC viewer with build sequence visualization. Load IFC files, animate the construction sequence step by step, and inspect element properties.

loading.title: IFC file loading
loading.desc: Drag and drop IFC files into the viewer or use the file picker. Parsed with the web-ifc library.

visualization.title: 3D visualization
visualization.desc: Interactive 3D rendering of BIM models with Three.js. Zoom, pan, and rotate around the model.

sequence.title: Build sequence animation
sequence.desc: Visualize the construction sequence step by step with play, pause, previous, and next controls. Choose which IFC parameter drives the sequence order.

properties.title: Element properties
properties.desc: Click on any element to select and highlight it. View all IFC properties of the selected element.

threejs.title: Three.js
threejs.desc: 3D rendering engine for interactive model visualization.

webifc.title: web-ifc
webifc.desc: IFC parsing library by IFCjs for reading Industry Foundation Classes files.

vanilla.title: Vanilla JavaScript
vanilla.desc: No framework dependencies. Lightweight and fast.
